results.sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,nickname TEXT DEFAULT "",avatar TEXT,visit_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,last_visit_at TEXT,created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

results.name: works
results.sql: CREATE TABLE works (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,work_id TEXT NOT NULL,title TEXT DEFAULT "",category TEXT DEFAULT "",synopsis TEXT DEFAULT "",payload TEXT DEFAULT "",version INTEGER DEFAULT 1,chapter_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,total_words INTEGER DEFAULT 0,created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
